articles.title: Right hand leads time
articles.body:
When things fall apart, simplify the right hand first. Time lives there.

Then bring the left hand back in at a tempo both can share.

articles.title: Economy of motion
articles.body: Smaller fretting motions are faster and cleaner. Watch for flying fingers and bring them home.

articles.title: Split the session
articles.body: Ten minutes of switches, then a song. Mixing both in one chaotic loop slows both.
